breachMonitor.title: Breach Monitor
breachMonitor.subtitle: Monitor your accounts for known security breaches.
breachMonitor.description: Monitor your vault credentials against the local offline HIBP dataset.

breachMonitor.hashedComparisonsDesc: We only monitor anonymized hashes to ensure your privacy is absolute.

emergency.title: Emergency Access
emergency.subtitle: Account Recovery Protocol
emergency.setupDesc: Designate a trusted individual who can request access to your vault in the event of an emergency. This protocol uses a zero-knowledge wait period: any request triggers an immediate alert to you, giving you time to deny it. Silence during the wait period constitutes authorization.
emergency.setupInfo: Your trusted contact will only be able to decrypt your vault after the waiting period expires and only if you haven't denied the request.
emergency.urlDesc: Provide this link to your trusted contact. They must visit this URL to initiate the access protocol.
emergency.auditLogDesc: Below are all recorded attempts to activate the emergency protocol for your account.

setup.welcomeDesc: Your self-hosted, open-source password manager — built for security-conscious teams and individuals.
setup.aboutText1: PWDnow stores all credentials locally — no cloud, no telemetry, no vendor lock-in. You own your data.
setup.aboutText2: Supports TOTP, WebAuthn hardware keys, and email OTP for multi-factor authentication. Full audit log. Recovery kit. Emergency access controls.

setup.proFeature1Sub: 10 years of security patches for 30,000+ packages
setup.proFeature2Sub: Certified OpenSSL, kernel crypto — enabled automatically on attach

setup.fipsNote: Ubuntu Pro currently ships FIPS 140-2 validated modules; FIPS 140-3 module rollout is in progress upstream. PWDnow's vault daemon cryptography is FIPS 140-3-aligned — see Technical Reference §6.0.
